normative_summary: Authored TemplateUse kind is exactly templateUse.
TemplateUse is a structural Node in the shared NodeContractCatalog, not Frame, Slot, sidecar, or callback.
TemplateUse is allowed only in parent ContentModels that admit it and cannot be DesignRoot.
TemplateUse requires kind, nodeId, useId, templateRef, contextSelector, fills, placement, and bindings.
TemplateUse optional fields are exactly displayName, render, visible, opacity, and transform.
templateRef is closed {templateId} and follows target current only.
nodeId and useId are namespace-local unique client-generated canonical UUID v4 values.
TemplateUse forbids children, appearance, fit/alignment, and child-override members.
All TemplateUse objects and unions reject unknown members, unknown kinds, and null.
bindings and fills members are mandatory even when empty.
displayName is authored hash content but is non-evaluated and non-bindable.
Every actual TemplateUse occurrence creates one isolated child invocation.
Shared target snapshot may share closure facts but never frame, fill, capability, Asset, path, or subtree results.
system-empty and five system-basic schemas are first-class immutable StaticSchemas with ordinary identity.
System schemas are selectable and referenceable, have no Draft, and are not evaluator-private contracts.
Each system-basic schema requires integer-decimal index and a correctly typed value.
Evaluator builds one immutable exact-system-schema context for each scalar Repeat item.
/index and loopIndex equal the original zero-based input index and are never renumbered by pruning or packing.
A matching system-basic child may receive the complete scalar item context.
Reference items retain only business schema and never gain implicit index; index transfer requires explicit PUBLIC fill.
contextSelector is a closed union.
Ordinary selector wire is exact invocation/loop-domain context plus pointer.
Empty selector is exact {kind:empty} and only valid for a system-empty child.
Empty pointer selects the complete typed context of the selected domain.
Non-empty pointer must be valid RFC6901 and statically resolve to a reference-typed object context.
Selectors reject scalar, array, numeric-index, wildcard, arbitrary-object, shape-inference, and JSON-revalidation paths.
Selected StaticSchemaRef must exactly equal the child permanent StaticSchemaRef.
Ordinary selector requires ERROR or SKIP absent policy; empty selector forbids it.
ERROR on legal runtime ABSENT terminates Evaluation.
SKIP removes the invocation and consumes no host layout/gap or downstream placement, fill, child, Asset, or capability work.
Empty selector always yields concrete system-empty context.
null, source ERROR, invalid or nonexistent pointer, wrong type, and schema mismatch are not ABSENT and cannot be hidden by SKIP.
Save validates every selector even in statically pruned structure.
Each fill has exact {targetDefinitionId,source} wire.
Fill target is unique per TemplateUse.
fills order has no semantics and canonicalizes by targetDefinitionId.
Fill target must be a child-current PUBLIC CustomDefinition and source type must match exactly.
Fill source evaluates in the parent TemplateUse lexical domain.
Fill directly permits only context, loopIndex, or definition sources and forbids literal and capability sources.
Capability-derived fill requires a parent Expression input; TemplateUse exposes no capability entry.
Omitted PUBLIC fill or legal ABSENT uses the child literal default.
ERROR, wrong type, invalid dynamic AssetRef, or budget failure never falls back to default.
PRIVATE definition always uses its child default.
Target removal, privacy change, or type drift is dependency ERROR and triggers recursive parent recheck.
Duplicate target or illegal source wire is hard error.
Child evaluation begins only after all PUBLIC fill/default and PRIVATE defaults are frozen.
Child frame cannot read parent frame.
Every Render freezes one consistent closure from all authored reachable TemplateRefs, including statically unreachable refs.
Closure snapshots deduplicate by templateId and pin exact current revision and contentHash.
Every authored TemplateUse remains a distinct closure edge.
Any current drift discards the closure attempt; only bounded retry or failure is allowed.
Closure validates scope, lifecycle, readiness, DAG, profile compatibility, and integrity before invocation pruning.
Structural pruning cannot hide invalid closure, remove delete blockers, or bypass static validation.
TemplateUse consumer order is render, selector/policy, placement, visible, opacity, transform, sorted fills, child frame, and child DFS.
Composite leaves follow NodeContract order; JSON or binding order cannot change first error.
render:false prunes before selector and all later work.
SKIP prunes immediately after selector and executes no later work.
visible:false and opacity:0 execute fill, child, and Asset work with normal failures.
First demanded runtime error fails fast with zero RenderDocument.
Template ownerScope is immutable after creation.
TemplateRef requires parent and target in the same scope.
Template copy is same-ownerScope only.
Cross-scope migration requires future explicit export/import and reference mapping; no deep copy or confirmed invalid cross-scope ref.
Authorized root Render uses internal capability for same-scope closure and authored child Assets without per-child caller read.
Directory, edit, draft-preview, and download retain their own read authorization.
Each actual child property Asset use creates a distinct resourceId and observes current independently.
Snapshot, asset, content, or definition equality never merges resolve occurrences; only exact-byte cache may reuse within Ticket13 boundaries.
Each Template exact Expression Profile supplies capability contracts to its actual child invocations.
Child Expression must explicitly declare capability input; TemplateUse cannot alter or save allowlists.
Invocations share request CapabilityState components and budgets while declaration frame makes call positions distinct.
Capability data is fully eliminated before RenderDocument.
Parent ContentModel selects ABSOLUTE, STACK, GRID, or PACK only for a Repeat direct child.
ABSOLUTE, STACK, and GRID allow FIXED, HUG, and FILL; PACK allows FIXED and HUG only.
Existing min, max, margin, cell, alignment, definite-FILL, and cycle rules remain applicable.
HUG intrinsic size is the child Canvas original trim size before min/max clamp.
FIXED or FILL host box is determined by parent layout.
Host size never reflows or changes child Canvas, Stack, Grid, or Text constraints.
Child subtree lays out against original trim constraints, then clips to source trim.
The whole source artboard maps by uniform CONTAIN and centered offset into the host.
Mapped child is clipped again to the host.
Concrete child background fills source trim before child paint.
Nested child bleed contributes to neither size, paint, nor clip.
CONTAIN letterbox is transparent and TemplateUse has no self paint.
visible, opacity, and transform apply exactly once at the host layer.
Child paints as one continuous subtree in parent authored order and cannot interleave siblings.
Evaluator completely removes TemplateUse and child Canvas.
Expanded child lowers to static compositionViewport with no ValueSource, ref, fill, or callback residue.
compositionViewport carries source trim, concrete background, CONTAIN/CENTER, and source/host clips.
Engine recursively lays out the child under source trim after host box is known, then computes contain transform.
Evaluator does not pre-layout or write final coordinates.
Nested uses lower recursively to nested static viewports without runtime Template reads.
Implementation must extend RenderDSL and pass Layout Profile conformance for compositionViewport.
Implementation must not preserve TemplateUse, pre-layout in Evaluator, rasterize child, or use an Engine callback.
Exploration creates no placeholder kind or API.
Each snapshot parses and evaluates with its own exact DSL and Expression profiles.
Root Design Profile maps through an append-only compatibility table to one exact Layout Profile.
Caller cannot select, negotiate, upgrade, request latest, or fall back the Layout Profile.
Every child Profile requires a permanent lossless edge to the root-selected Layout Profile including compositionViewport.
A missing edge fails before Evaluation and causes no migration, mutation, mixed profile, or partial document.
Request path uses closed ordered root, Repeat, TemplateUse, and node segments.
Outer Repeat segments precede use; child Repeat segments follow use.
Viewport role maps to source TemplateUse node; canvas-background role maps to child Canvas node.
Repeat and conditional synthetic roles remain as defined by Ticket11.
Synthetic nodes never receive UUIDs.
Skipped use creates no invocation, viewport, or descendant occurrence.
The same use at different input index and a shared child through different use or path are distinct occurrences.
RenderDocument carries only opaque occurrenceId.
Request sidecar maps path and source identity to problems, paint, and trace; Engine receives no Template identity.
Resolved revision is a request-local locator only.
Paths exclude context, fill, and item values and are not author, business, revision, or cross-request identities.
Paths do not enter Design hash or independently form cache identity.
Illegal wire, null, IDs, fills, children, placement, binding, selector, domain, or cycle is a non-confirmable hard error.
Well-formed child lifecycle, readiness, fill, context, schema, or profile failure is a dependency error eligible for confirmed INVALID save.
INVALID or STALE Template cannot Render.
Runtime selector, fill, child, Asset, capability, or capacity failure affects the request only, not readiness.
Static unreachability does not weaken problem classification.
Local TemplateUse copy generates fresh nodeId, useId, and bindingIds and atomically rewrites references.
Copy preserves templateRef and child targetDefinitionId.
Context or fill refs survive copy only if lexically reachable; otherwise the client copies, redirects, or rejects.
Reparent explicitly converts placement; server never guesses scope, placement, domain, or repairs IDs.
Whole Template copy or restore preserves local IDs.
Child current save and DAG check are atomic; a cycle causes zero write.
Valid child current change marks incoming active parents STALE then rechecks recursively without changing parent revision or hash.
Refs in render:false or unreachable branches still propagate invalidation and block child deletion.
All authored TemplateUse, common, parent-position, and logical-ref facts enter canonical Design and content hash.
fills sort by targetDefinitionId, bindings by bindingId, and parent children retain semantic order.
Resolved child current, closure, runtime context, fill, path, viewport, contain, and expanded subtree do not enter parent hash.
Active-current projection retains every authored use logical target and stable parent locator.
Projection queries may aggregate target but cannot lose use occurrences or become fact authority.
All authored edges participate in DAG, readiness, and delete blocking.
Capacity independently limits closure snapshots, edges, depth, invocation count and depth, viewports, nodes, and paint items.
SKIP or pruning consumes closure budgets but not actual invocation, materialization, capability, or Asset budgets.
A shared snapshot counts once; every actual invocation counts separately.
Parent dependency diagnostics expose bounded parent-side IDs, pointer, and target details.
Child runtime diagnostics use bounded invocation or occurrence and child-local identities.
Diagnostics never echo context, fill, text, child DSL, or Asset bytes.
Cross-permission detail may redact but must preserve the parent use locator.
Problem truncation explicitly emits PROBLEM_LIMIT_REACHED.

v1 excludes all listed dynamic selectors, schema inference, cross-scope or deep copy, slots, fallbacks, overrides, inheritance, callbacks, configurable viewport behavior, memoized invocation, child output, and multi-Canvas features.
Any excluded capability requires a new Design or Layout Profile plus explicit migration.
v1 persists neither nullable placeholders nor parsed-but-unimplemented fields.
